reviews.title: Nice idea and pleasant app
reviews.text: Impressed with the design and layout. Well executed idea.

reviews.title: So easy to start using
reviews.text: I downloaded it, opened it, and was adding memories right away. No sign up, no ads, nothing in the way. You just add a card or a drawing, drop it in a box, and it is saved…going back to look at old ones feels calm and nice. Five stars. ✅
